passages.text: Example Co. is an office furniture manufacturer with about 150 employees and four departments: Product Development, Operations, People, and Sales.
Office hours are 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., Monday to Friday, with a one-hour lunch break.
Annual leave depends on length of service: 3 days after six months and 7 days after one year.
The People team is managed by Yizhen Wu, who handles recruiting, training, and employee relations.
